articles.summary: Kairos Pharma, Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on overcoming cancer drug resistance, announces that Neil Bhowmick, President and Chief Scientific Officer, will both present and moderate a discussion in person at the 24 th Annual Discovery on Target Drug Discovery Conference. The conference is being held on Sept. 28 to Oct. 1 at the Sheraton Boston Hotel with sessions available on demand on the conference’s website . Bhowmick will moderate an in-person only breakout session on Sept. 30 titled, “Winning the Race against Cancer Therapy Resistance,” focused on Kairos’ primary strategy of targeting cancer drug resistance for patients with high unmet need in order to extend the efficacy of previously effective drug candidates instead of simply moving on to the next drug candidate when resistance takes hold.
